base.alt: Concept image: a dated but working bathroom with a builder vanity and tired walls, before any styling.

baseVariants.prompt: A realistic photograph of an ordinary, dated but complete small bathroom in a 2000s Midwest American suburban house, not luxury. A builder oak vanity with a cultured marble top and a plain chrome faucet, a plain frameless mirror above it with a chrome vanity light bar, a white toilet, a white tub and shower combination with a plain white surround and no shower curtain, a frosted window, a light tile floor, thin builder baseboards. Bright soft daylight. Clean: no towels, no rugs, no decor, nothing on the walls. One large plain painted wall is clearly visible. Eye-level camera from the doorway. No people, no text, no logos. Natural colour, gentle shadows, 4:3 photograph. The walls are painted a dated 1990s pinkish beige that looks a little dingy.

stages.caption: Beadboard on the lower walls first: practical in a bathroom, and it says cottage straight away.
The vanity stays. A round rattan mirror, sconces instead of the light bar, and a nickel faucet.
A striped shower curtain, fresh towels and a woven mat.
A small print, a basket and a plant, and it feels like a different room.

final.alt: Concept image: the same bathroom, restyled with beadboard, a rattan mirror, nickel sconces, a striped shower curtain, towels and a bath mat.
